tools_tuned.name: turn_on_light

tools_tuned.name: turn_off_light

tools_tuned.name: set_light_brightness
tools_tuned.description: Set a room's light brightness to a percentage the user stated. Use for 'dim', 'brighten', 'set to N percent'. The number comes from the request.

tools_tuned.name: set_light_color
tools_tuned.description: Set a room's light colour to a colour the user named. Only for colours: warm white, cool white, red, green, blue.

tools_tuned.name: set_temperature
tools_tuned.description: Set a room's target temperature in whole degrees Celsius, 10 to 30. Use for 'set to N degrees', 'make it N'. Never use this for lights.

tools_tuned.name: get_temperature
tools_tuned.description: Read a room's current temperature in degrees Celsius. Use this first whenever the request depends on how warm or cold a room currently is.

tools_tuned.name: open_blinds
tools_tuned.description: Open a room's blinds. Use for 'open', 'raise', 'let the light in'.

tools_tuned.name: close_blinds
tools_tuned.description: Close a room's blinds. Use for 'close', 'shut', 'lower', 'blinds down'.

tools_tuned.name: play_music

tools_tuned.name: stop_music

tools_tuned.name: create_event

tools_tuned.name: move_event

tools_tuned.name: cancel_event

tools_tuned.name: find_free_slot

tools_tuned.name: find_file
tools_tuned.description: Search documents by name or folder. Use this first whenever the request names a document in words rather than by id. Searches files, not calendar events.

tools_tuned.name: read_file

tools_tuned.name: rename_file
tools_tuned.description: Change a document's name. The new name must be stated in the request.

tools_tuned.name: move_file
tools_tuned.description: Move a document into a folder. Moves files; never use this on calendar events. Folders: finance, product, team, archive.

tools_tuned.name: delete_file

tools_tuned.name: share_file
tools_tuned.description: Give another person access to a document. The recipient must be named in the request.
